_comment: Missy policy: the pool-eligibility gates Missy enforces and the default scoring model it emits. This is the single source of truth for Missy's feature/score output. Sheldon owns strategy policy (thresholds, sizing, windows, execution rails) and may override or recompute the score for backtesting; George enforces execution rails only.

pool_eligibility._comment: Pre-scoring eligibility gates. A pool that fails is still emitted with eligible=false and rejected_reason so the audit trail survives.
